server_name.description: The server's public hostname (must be unique in the network).

server_info.description: A short human-readable description of the server.

server_webirc_enabled.description: Enable WebIRC gateway support (allows web-based clients to pass real IP and host info).

max_connections.description: Maximum number of simultaneous client connections allowed.

max_connections_per_ip.description: Maximum number of connections allowed from a single IP address.

max_log_entries.description: Maximum number of log entries kept in memory.

timeout_seconds.description: Time (in seconds) before idle connections are dropped.

ping_timeout_seconds.description: Time (in seconds) before a client is pinged for response.

pong_timeout_seconds.description: Time (in seconds) to wait for a client pong before disconnecting.

listen_ports.description: List of ports to listen on for plain IRC connections.

listen_addresses.description: List of IP addresses (or hostnames) to bind IRC services to.

ssl_cipher_list.description: OpenSSL-compatible cipher list for TLS connections.

ssl_dhfile.description: Path to Diffie-Hellman parameters file (optional but recommended for stronger DH key exchange).

ssl_key_file.description: Path to server's private key file for TLS.

ssl_cert_file.description: Path to server's public certificate file for TLS.

ssl_ca_file.description: Path to CA bundle for verifying client certificates (optional).

ssl_verify_mode.description: Client certificate verification mode for TLS.

ssl_ports.description: List of ports to listen on for TLS-encrypted IRC connections.

password_hash.description: Crypt-encrypted password (e.g., SHA256) or '!' to disable login.

host.description: Hostmask (or IP/CIDR) from which operator can connect (supports wildcards).

operators.description: List of IRC operators with privileged access.

channel_max_users_per_channel.description: Maximum number of users allowed in a single channel.

channel_topic_protection.description: Require channel operator to change topic (prevents user-initiated topic changes).

channel_default_key.description: Default channel key (password) to use for newly created channels (optional).

channel_max_channels_per_user.description: Maximum number of channels a single user may join simultaneously.

syslog_facility.description: Syslog facility to use for logging.

log_file_path.description: Path to the log file for persistent logs (empty string disables file logging).

webirc_enabled.description: Enable WebIRC proxy support — required for HTTP clients via mod_exec.

webirc_url.description: Base URL of the WebIRC proxy (e.g., a frontend HTTP server forwarding requests to ngIRCd).

webirc_exec_path.description: Path to the mod_exec CGI/HTTP gateway executable.

module_path.description: Directory where ngIRCd modules (e.g., mod_exec) are installed.

module_config_path.description: Path to the mod_exec-specific configuration file.

module_exec_path.description: Path to the mod_exec shared library (used for HTTP/CGI support).
